name: Fudgy Brownies
description: One bowl of pantry staples, fudgy middles and a crackly top. Cut them small; they're rich.
notes: Makes 16 squares in an 8×8-inch (20×20 cm) pan.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 8×8-inch (20×20 cm) pan with parchment, leaving some overhang to lift the brownies out.
Stir the melted butter and sugar together in a large bowl. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla, until glossy.
Sift in the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder and fold until just combined.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan.

instructions.text: Bake until the edges are set and a toothpick in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs, 25–30 minutes.
Cool completely in the pan, at least 1 hour, before lifting out and cutting into squares.

tips: For a crackly top, beat the eggs and sugar hard for a minute before adding the rest.
Stir in ½ cup (85 g) chocolate chips or chopped nuts with the flour.
Underbaked is better than overbaked: they firm up as they cool.
